name: Lumiere
description:
Lumiere is a video intelligence and audience research platform from Latitude that helps teams understand their content and how viewers respond.

Connect Lumiere to Claude to explore your video library, search transcripts and moments, analyze viewer feedback, and interpret engagement data through conversation. Find relevant scenes by meaning, investigate audience reactions, and compare findings across videos using evidence from your workspace.

Use the connector to prepare research summaries, explore responses to trailers and advertising, identify themes in viewer comments, or develop a stakeholder readout grounded in source feedback and video context.

Sign in with your Lumiere account and choose a workspace to connect. The connector provides read-only access to content and insights available to your account.

Learn more at https://lumiere.ai

_published_faq.name: How do I add Lumiere to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Lumiere to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://lumiere.ai/app/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Lumiere MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lumiere lists 19 MCP tools, including getAggregations, getCaptions, getChannelInsightsTable, getChannelVideos, getCollectionItems, getComments, getContentIntelligence, getFolderContents, getItemByIngestionId, getItemMetadata, getMoments, and getPodVideos.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Lumiere?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Lumiere in media-entertainment on the Manufact MCP catalog include Credits.fm, SceneF, HANKOOKILBO MCP, Ticketbox.vn, and drawnames.
Lumiere requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Lumiere is developed by Latitude. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
